name: imcp
summary: Access calendar, contacts, messages, reminders, mail, notes, music, home, maps and more on macOS
description: Bridges to iMCP 1.8.2+, exposing macOS-native services to the assistant: Calendar (list calendars; fetch, create, update events), Contacts (search, create, update), Messages (history with chatId and attachments via messages_attachment_read), Reminders (fetch, create, update, delete, recurrence; create, rename, delete lists), Phone calls (history), Voicemail (list, transcripts, audio), Mail (read-only search and read, plus mail_compose to open a draft), Notes, Voice Memos, Music (now playing, catalog search, control), Home (HomeKit; requires the self-signed iMCP Helper), Location, Maps (search, directions, ETA, explore, static images), Weather, Shortcuts (list and run), Capture (camera, audio, screenshot), and Utilities. Large binary results may be truncated by the 256 KiB / 10 s bridge limits. The tool surface is gated twice: by the services the operator enabled in the macOS app and by the host bridge allowlist. Call imcp_list_tools to discover what is available.
instructions: Install the public standalone plugin repository at https://github.com/diegopetrucci/stavrobot-imcp-plugin. Its repository root must contain manifest.json; the canonical plugin files are kept at this repository root alongside the host source, and consumers install the published URL. Manually prepare the host bridge on a Mac running iMCP 1.8.2 or newer; the host launches the bundled imcp-server over stdio, while this plugin continues to use the authenticated HTTP bridge contract. Configure bridge_url and bridge_token through Stavrobot web settings or a trusted host-side secret path; never paste bridge_token into agent chat. The default bridge URL is http://host.docker.internal:8766/bridge. The token is used only for authentication and is never included in tool responses or errors.

bridge_url.description: HTTP URL of the host iMCP bridge.

bridge_token.description: Bearer token configured for the host iMCP bridge.
